title: Pushforward of a perfect complex along an open immersion with closed support of its cohomology is perfect
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves), section on perfect complexes
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for an open immersion j : U -> X, the pushforward Rj_*E of a perfect complex E on U is perfect on X whenever the cohomology sheaves of E are supported on a closed subset T with j(T) closed in X. The proof rests on locality of perfectness, splits the check into the two-part open cover U, V = X \ j(T), and uses that Rj_*E restricts to E on U and vanishes on V because E vanishes on U \ T (proof lines 12707-12710). H2: the support hypothesis is what makes V open and the vanishing on V valid; identifying that is the non-routine step.
